extracted.name: Homemade Decorating Frosting
extracted.description: Make this pure white cake frosting recipe with shortening, confectioners’ sugar, milk, and almond extract for smooth frosting or detailed cake decorations.
instruction_lines: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Beat on low speed of electric mixer until well blended and very smooth, about 3 to 5 minutes.
